title: A projective resolution of the symplectic Steinberg module
summary: Borel--Serre proved that for a number ring $R$ with fraction field $K$, the symplectic group $\text{Sp}_{2n}(R)$ is a virtual duality group of degree quadratic in $n$, and that the symplectic Steinberg module $\text{St}^ω_{2n}(K)$ is its dualizing module. We construct a projective resolution of this symplectic Steinberg module as an $\text{Sp}_{2n}(R)$-representation, that is similar in form to a resolution of Lee--Szczarba for the special linear group, but whose construction is more involved.
